replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Welcome to the forums!!
Here are the rules.

If you have any questions, feel free to ask!
We'll be more than happy to help you out!

Currently, you cannot friend people. But in the Winter update that is coming soon, you will be able to.

When this is implemented, go onto the person's profile and click the "Add Friend" button near the top right of their page.
